columnPool.label: Route: Great Western Main Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Great Western Main Line route
columnPool.hint: The core route from London Paddington to Bristol and beyond, via Reading, Swindon and Bath Spa - the trunk line most other GWR West Country services join at Bristol Parkway or Bristol Temple Meads.

columnPool.label: Route: Heart of Wessex Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Heart of Wessex Line route
columnPool.hint: The route from Bristol Temple Meads via Bath, Westbury, Castle Cary and Yeovil to the seaside town of Weymouth.

columnPool.label: Route: Oxford & Hereford Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Oxford & Hereford Line route
columnPool.hint: The route from Oxford through the Cotswolds via Charlbury, Kingham and Moreton-in-Marsh to Worcester and Hereford - also called the Cotswold Line for its scenic eastern section.

columnPool.label: Route: Golden Valley Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Golden Valley Line route
columnPool.hint: The route from Swindon via Kemble to Cheltenham and Gloucester - despite the name, mostly follows the Thames and Churn valleys rather than a 'Golden Valley' as such.

columnPool.label: Route: North Downs
columnPool.display: Is part of the North Downs route
columnPool.hint: The cross-country route from Reading via Guildford to Redhill, running along the foot of the North Downs and linking several radial lines out of London.

columnPool.label: Route: Tarka Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Tarka Line route
columnPool.hint: The rural branch from Exeter via Crediton and Eggesford to Barnstaple in North Devon, named after Henry Williamson's otter novel 'Tarka the Otter', set along this route.

columnPool.label: Route: Cornish Main Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Cornish Main Line route
columnPool.hint: The backbone of Cornwall's railway, running from Plymouth via Liskeard, Bodmin Parkway, St Austell and Truro to Penzance - the route most Cornish branch lines connect into.

columnPool.label: Route: Exmouth Branch
columnPool.display: Is part of the Exmouth Branch route
columnPool.hint: The branch from Exeter via Topsham and Lympstone to the seaside town of Exmouth on the Exe Estuary - also known as the Avocet Line.

columnPool.label: Route: Berks & Hants Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Berks & Hants Line route
columnPool.hint: The route from Reading via Newbury and Bedwyn towards Westbury and the West Country, running through Berkshire and Hampshire as the name suggests.

columnPool.label: Route: Severn Beach Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Severn Beach Line route
columnPool.hint: The scenic Bristol suburban branch from Temple Meads through Clifton Down, Sea Mills and Avonmouth to the small resort of Severn Beach on the Severn Estuary.

columnPool.label: Route: Tamar Valley Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Tamar Valley Line route
columnPool.hint: The scenic branch from Plymouth up the Tamar Valley via Bere Alston and Calstock to Gunnislake, crossing into Cornwall over the Calstock Viaduct.

columnPool.label: Route: Atlantic Coast Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Atlantic Coast Line route
columnPool.hint: The branch from Par via Bugle and Roche to the surfing resort of Newquay on Cornwall's north coast.

columnPool.label: Route: Riviera Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Riviera Line route
columnPool.hint: The route from Exeter along the Exe Estuary and the coast via Dawlish and Teignmouth to Torquay and Paignton on the 'English Riviera'.

columnPool.label: Route: Greenford Branch
columnPool.display: Is part of the Greenford Branch route
columnPool.hint: The short branch line from West Ealing via South Greenford to its terminus at Greenford.

columnPool.label: Route: Looe Valley Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Looe Valley Line route
columnPool.hint: The branch from Liskeard down the East Looe river valley to the seaside town of Looe.
